Convert findings to a running missing-ratio timeseries for CTAS

Transform_Missing.Rd

Consumes the long-format frame produced by Standardize_Domain() and replaces value with a running missing ratio per (subject, parameter, visit) so CTAS can score sites on data-completeness patterns. Rows with NA values are kept because they carry the signal. Fields that are NA for every row are kept as well (their ratio is a constant 1) and listed in a message so the all-missing case is explicit.

Usage

Transform_Missing(dfInput, strPrefix = "MISS")

Arguments

dfInput

data.frame Long-format output of Standardize_Domain().

strPrefix

character Prefix for the generated parameter_id.

Value

data.frame in the CTAS long-format vocabulary. parameter_id is prefixed with strPrefix; parameter_category_2 keeps the raw input parameter_id so ctasapp can stitch this metric with sibling metrics on the same field.

Data Specification

dfInput must include:

  • subject_id - Subject identifier.

  • parameter_id - Raw test code (e.g. LBTESTCD).

  • parameter_name - Human-readable test label.

  • parameter_category_1 - Domain label (e.g. "Labs").

  • parameter_category_2 - Field anchor; retained as the grouping key.

  • visit, visitnum - Visit label and numeric ordering.

  • value - Numeric result; NA carries the missingness signal.
